welcome.headline: Your next workout adapts to how you perform.
welcome.subtitle: Short 5, 10, or 15-minute core workouts. No fixed calendar—just clear, gradual progress.
analytics.description: Anonymous usage data helps us improve the app. Personal or health information is not shared.
safety.title: Train safely
safety.scope: Adaptive Core provides general fitness guidance for adults aged 18 and over. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or provide rehabilitation for any condition.
safety.consult: If you are pregnant, injured, have a health condition, or have been advised to limit exercise, speak with a qualified healthcare professional before starting.
safety.stop: Stop exercising if you feel pain, dizziness, chest discomfort, or unusual shortness of breath. Seek urgent medical help if symptoms are severe or do not go away.
safety.confirm: I am 18 or older and I understand.
onboarding.exp.title: How familiar are you with core training?
onboarding.exp.helper: This helps us choose a safe starting point.
onboarding.dur.title: How long would you like most workouts to be?
onboarding.dur.helper: You can change this before any workout.
onboarding.limit.title: Is there anything we should avoid today?
onboarding.limit.ongoing: I have an ongoing movement limitation
onboarding.limit.helper: We use this only to avoid unsuitable movements—not to diagnose a condition.
baseline.title: Let's find your starting point
baseline.description: You'll try up to three short movements. This takes about 2–3 minutes and is not a maximum-effort test.
baseline.safety: Move slowly and stay within a comfortable range. Stop immediately if you feel pain.
today.why_first: Built from your preferred duration, experience, movement limitations, and baseline results.
complete.title: Workout complete
complete.question: How did this workout feel overall?
adaptation.second_easy: You handled this level well twice. We'll increase one part of your next similar workout by a small step.
adaptation.appropriate: This level felt appropriate, so your next similar workout will stay here.
adaptation.hard: This workout felt hard. We'll keep the load stable and give you 15 seconds more rest next time.
adaptation.incomplete: You couldn't complete this workout, so the next one will be lighter.
adaptation.pain: We've excluded the movement that caused discomfort. It won't appear in upcoming workouts for now.
save.prompt: Save your progress and get your next adapted workout.
save.title: Save your progress
save.description: Create an account to keep your baseline, workout results, movement exclusions, and future adaptations together.
save.warning: Without an account, your progress stays only on this device and may be lost if the app is removed.
beta.title: Would you continue with Adaptive Core?
beta.description: Your first two adaptive workouts are included. Ongoing adaptive training is planned at **{localized_price} / {billing_period}**.
beta.notice: The closed beta is free. You won't be charged today.
paid.title: Keep your workouts adapting
paid.description: Continue with workouts built from your performance, recovery, and recent history.
paid.terms: {localized_price} / {billing_period}. Auto-renews unless cancelled. Manage or cancel anytime through your store account.
progress.title: Your progress
progress.empty: Your progress starts with your first workout.
pain.title: Stop this movement
pain.message: Don't continue through pain. We've removed **{exercise_name}** from this workout and will avoid it in future workouts for now.
pain.consult: If the pain is severe, continues after stopping, or worries you, speak with a qualified healthcare professional.
pain.emergency: For chest pain, fainting, or severe or unusual shortness of breath, stop exercising and contact local emergency services.
no_sub.title: We've shortened this workout
no_sub.message: There isn't a suitable replacement that meets your current safety settings. Skipping this movement is the safer choice.
no_workout.title: Rest is the right choice today
no_workout.message: We couldn't build a workout that meets your current safety settings. You haven't lost progress.
media.unavailable: Demo unavailable. You can continue with the written cues or choose another movement.
resume.title: You have a workout in progress
resume.message: Continue from where you stopped. Your completed sets are saved.
offline.cached: You're offline. Your workout is saved on this device and will sync when you reconnect.
offline.no_cache: A connection is needed to prepare your next workout.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: Your completed workout data is safe. Try again to continue.
